main_topics.reason: The user opened asking what else exists beyond the pill and spent most turns comparing progestin, Mirena and GnRH options.
Pain creeping back and worst in the pill-free week is the trigger for the whole conversation.
The user asked if there is anything besides hormones, leading to several turns on pain services, physio and surgery.
The user said they were discharged to the GP after the laparoscopy and the bot advised seeking re-referral, which became a key next step.
The bot suggested skipping the break week and the user had never heard of it; it is the first item on their plan.
The user asked whether physio would need to be private, and it was covered in a single exchange.
The user voiced worry about GnRH treatment sounding scary, and said they were reassured after one answer.
The user remarked in one line that being discharged back to the GP felt rubbish given where disease was found.
The user said they were tired of everything being about hormones, mentioned briefly before moving to alternatives.

output.summary: A user whose combined pill had stopped controlling their endometriosis pain asked what other options exist. The bot covered continuous pill use, progestin options, the Mirena, GnRH medications, non-hormonal support and re-referral to a specialist after the user said disease was found near the bowel and ovary. The user ended with a clear list to take to their GP and said they felt less stuck.
